blocks.text: From bibingka and puto bumbong after Simbang Gabi to Cebuano torta, budbud, and other familiar delicacies shared over merienda, food is part of how Cebuanos experience Christmas. These Filipino Christmas food favorites bring together seasonal cravings and local food traditions, showing how familiar flavors can make the holidays feel special beyond the main family feast. From Christmas rice cakes to Cebuano delicacies Few foods signal the approaching holidays quite like bibingka and puto bumbong.
